messages:
toni: Quick RFC follow-up: testing a micro-pinned-lease primitive to reduce streaming tail spikes. grant a small slab-aligned GPU window for T ms per request. thoughts?

kim: Short list of concerns: fragmentation if many tiny leases, NUMA cross-node costs, and revoke races.

raj: Implementation notes: allocate slab-aligned chunks (4KiB min), issue lease token, async revoke notice on pressure, runtime checks token at safe points. Keep a short free-list to recycle chunks.

toni: Telemetry to add: lease_grants, lease_revokes, avg_hold_ms, p99_lat_with_lease, pinned_pages_by_tenant, cross_numa_pct.

kim: Rollout plan: feature-flag = micro_pin, stage=grant-only to collect metrics, then enable revoke. Add tenant soft-quota to avoid noisy-tenants.

ci-bot: bench: branch micro-pin reported a revoke-path race; pinned_count mismatch on stress-5. Link: https://ci.fake/micro-pin/5 (short)

raj: I'll add atomic refcount and unit tests for revoke path. also add coalesce pass on free to avoid long-term fragmentation.

toni: Great. I'll draft the RFC follow-up and include config schema + canary checklist. Thanks all.
